context_plan.expected_behavior: Exercise labels should become less sensitive to individual high-leverage paths and noisy continuation targets, yielding a more stable boundary and higher genuinely out-of-sample discounted payoff. The ridge references’ scores motivate retaining a linear representation, but do not establish that leave-one-out induction is causal; the proposed gain comes specifically from changing how training-path stopping decisions are generated.

From the selected ridge fit compute fitted values yhat, residuals r, and leverage h_i = x_i^T(X^T X + lambda I)^{-1}x_i. Use continuation_i_LOO = yhat_i - h_i*r_i/max(1-h_i, 1e-3) solely to update each training path’s exercise/cash-flow decision. context_plan.mechanism: Replace in-sample backward induction with leave-one-out ridge LSM. The parent uses each path both to fit its continuation value and to decide that path’s exercise action, creating influential-path bias with only 256 paths. Analytic leave-one-out predictions provide an approximately out-of-sample stopping decision without sacrificing data to fixed folds.
